name: Fudgy Chocolate Walnut Brownie (Dense Cocoa & Nut Warning)
whyItWorks: Combines dense cocoa fats with hard, angular walnut chunks. Cocoa stimulates colonic motility, while walnut fragments resist digestion and scrape inflamed ulcer beds in the ileum and colon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid brownies baked with whole nuts. If in remission, choose a plain, nut-free cake brownie without chocolate chips.
watchOuts: Hard walnut pieces pose acute stricture blockage risks; heavy cocoa accelerates bowel urgency.
